idle.process: WeChatUnrevoke.app：主进程、辅助进程与子进程合计
idle.scope: 主进程 + XPC 辅助进程 + 子进程合计
idle.method: 正式 1.0.9 安装版，open -n -g -j；NSUserDefaults 参数域 everProtected=NO 阻止自动写入；只读状态检查，不执行补丁或消息操作。45 秒静置，60 秒 CPU 窗口，之后 3 次 phys_footprint 合计峰值。
idle.cpu_note: 60 秒实测界面及辅助进程 CPU 0.03%；另加同一 1.0.9 发布包每 30 分钟完整检查的 CPU 时间折算，总计约 0.07%。启动速度和完整检查数据沿用同一二进制的 5 次实测，原记录整机负载约 27。
idle.cpu_note_en: The 60-second idle window measured 0.03% CPU for the app and helpers; including a full check every 30 minutes gives about 0.07%. Launch and full-check timings retain five measurements of the identical 1.0.9 binary at a system load average near 27.

background.job: 窗口打开时每 60 秒比对微信包 5 个路径的文件指纹；指纹变了或距上次完整检查满 30 分钟才起 wechattweak doctor
background.note: per_run_s 与 cpu_s_per_run 为 1.0.9 发布包引擎 5 次 /usr/bin/time 中位（含 codesign 等子进程），测于整机负载约 27 时，见 perf/raw/ab-launch-1.0.8-vs-1.0.9.txt；同条件交替测 1.0.8 引擎为 2.49 s / 0.67 s CPU。指纹比对不起进程，每次不到 1 毫秒，未计。关窗后停止，按全天开着窗口折算
background.job_en: With the window open, compare five WeChat bundle fingerprints every minute; run the full status check on change or every 30 minutes.

data: 正式安装版，真实微信包的只读状态；自动写入在本次测量进程禁用，未执行补丁或消息操作。
data_en: Official installed app reading the real WeChat bundle; automatic writes disabled for this measurement process, with no patch or message operation.

speed_gui.label: 后台打开（open -n -g -j）到首个状态检查子进程退出、界面拿到状态
speed_gui.label_en: Background open (open -n -g -j) until the first status-check subprocess exits and the UI has the status
speed_gui.load: 整机 1 分钟负载均值约 27（本机其他应用占用）；与 1.0.8 发布包交替测，1.0.8 中位 3457 ms

speed_gui.label: 后台打开到窗口出现（launchtime，5 次）
speed_gui.label_en: Background open until the window exists (launchtime, 5 runs)
speed_gui.load: 负载均值 33–66；同条件 1.0.8 中位 1530 ms

why: 原生 SwiftUI 界面，无 Python 运行时；读写微信交给包内的 Swift 命令行引擎。窗口打开时每 60 秒只比对一次微信安装包里 5 个路径的文件指纹（不到 1 毫秒），微信没被更新、打补丁或还原就不启动引擎，另每 30 分钟完整检查一次兜底；关窗即停，无常驻后台服务。发布包剥离调试符号。
why_en: Native SwiftUI with no Python runtime. Reading and patching WeChat is handed to the bundled Swift command-line engine. While the window is open, it compares a file fingerprint of 5 paths in the WeChat bundle once a minute (under a millisecond) and starts the engine only when WeChat was updated, patched or restored, plus a full check every 30 minutes as a backstop; checks stop when the window closes. No resident background service. Release builds are stripped of debug symbols.

comparison_1_0_8.note: 同设备同日、同一微信（269627）下 1.0.8 与 1.0.9 发布包并排/交替实测，整机负载约 22–66（本机其他应用占用），两版同受影响
